resources.string: Bubble Keyboard is your current keyboard
How see-through the bubble is while it rests; it turns solid when you open it
How far keys grow and slide out from under your finger in a bloom
How long the open ring waits untouched before folding up. The arc around the center counts it down; it pauses while you dictate.
Rotate the letter bloom to fit
Turns the letters toward the middle of the screen when the bubble sits near an edge
Tap here, then tap the bubble

Tap the bubble to open the ring and start talking hands free (or, with that setting off, just open it); hold it to talk while held. While you talk, backspace becomes a red ✕ that throws the dictation away. In the ring, tap the center to start or stop dictation, or hold it to talk while held. Arrows type when tapped; tap then tap-and-hold an arrow to repeat it (up and backspace also repeat on a plain hold). Hold right, down or left and an icon appears beyond the key: slide out onto it and let go to switch keyboards (right), open these settings (down), or fold the ring up (left). Hold abc for letters, space for punctuation, enter for numbers: slide to a key and let go to type it, or slide back to cancel. Keep holding abc still and a full keyboard grid comes out and stays open: tap away, ⇧ for a capital (double tap for caps lock), and abc becomes ✕ to put it away. Drag the center to move it. While talking with a hold, slide away before letting go to throw it out.

Hold the folded bubble and talk. ElevenLabs Scribe turns speech into text as you speak; Claude can then tidy it up before it\'s typed. Your audio and text go to those services under your own API keys, which are stored encrypted on this phone.
Allow the microphone in Bubble Keyboard settings
Needs speech-to-text access. Create one at elevenlabs.io under Developers → API keys.
Removes filler words, fixes punctuation and applies spoken corrections (\"Tuesday, no, Wednesday\"). Adds a short pause after you let go. Create a key at console.anthropic.com.
The fastest model works best here.
Paste a new key to replace the saved one
Couldn\'t store the key securely on this phone
Words appear in the text field as you talk, and the polished version replaces them when it\'s ready. Off: words preview above the bubble and are typed when you finish. Password fields always preview.
One tap opens the ring already listening, hands free; tap the center to finish, or the red ✕ (where backspace is) to throw it away. Off: a tap just opens the ring.

Dictated messages never end with a period, because a final period reads as cold. Question marks, exclamation marks and periods between sentences stay. Keep talking after a message and its period comes back before the new words.
Hands-free dictation finishes by itself after this long without speech. The arc around the mic counts it down and refills whenever you talk.
